title: Ryanair CEO Apologizes for Calling Competitors 'High-Fare Rapists'
summary: Ryanair CEO Michael O'Leary has apologized for referring to competing airlines as 'high-fare rapists'. He described his choice of language as 'careless' and stated that such remarks would not be repeated. O'Leary expressed his regret, saying, 'I am truly sorry.' The comments were made in reference to other airlines in the industry.
summary_points: Ryanair CEO Michael O'Leary issued an apology for his remarks.
O'Leary had previously described competing airlines as 'high-fare rapists'.
He characterized his language as 'careless' and promised it would not happen again.
